topFindings.title: Real/approx light routing is INVERTED vs the engine's own IsValidRealLight classification
topFindings.evidence: Env.cpp:172 IsValidRealLight = (kPoint||kFakeSpot); AddLight routes those to mLightsReal, directionals to mLightsApprox which the Wii folds into box AMBIENT (Env.cpp:308). Our venue path (Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:1482-1519) reads mLightsApprox and promotes them to Lambert directionals; the char path reads mLightsReal (point+fakespot only) so its type==1 directional loop is dead and it extracts point lights only.

topFindings.title: Wii box-ambient (approx lights, 6-axis, per-object) is not modeled at all
topFindings.evidence: RndEnviron::UpdateApproxLighting (Env.cpp:308) queues approx lights into BoxMapLighting -> ApplyQueuedLights(boxResults[6], pos) -> GXColor[6] ambient cube. Engine collapses to a single scalar SceneUniforms.ambientColor with clamp/floor/grey-key/char-cap knobs (Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:1439-1554).

topFindings.title: Gameplay highway is not lit — it is per-draw material-color surgery keyed on cam+material name strings
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:6160-6205: cam->Name()=='game.cam' && mat->Name()=='surface.mat' -> color*=0.12; rails.tex force prelit; gem glow x2. game.cam never reads an environ (falls to the 1-white-dir + 0.45-grey default at :1560-1563).

topFindings.title: Fog, shadows, and spot/projected lights are hard-off in the RB3 scene path
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:1566-1568 set fogEnabled=0, shadowEnabled=0, numProjLights=0 unconditionally, despite SceneUniforms carrying all three and RndEnviron holding real fog data (Env.h:52) and kFakeSpot lights being real (Lit.cpp:40). Light packing loop (:1486-1519) drops type==2/3.

topFindings.title: Faithful pieces already present: unlit/prelit/lit taxonomy, per-environ granularity, GX point-falloff law
topFindings.evidence: MaterialUniforms.unlit maps rndwii/Mat.cpp:261 (!mUseEnviron&&!mPreLit); three shader branches (standard_wgsl.inc:841) match the three GX channel-ctrl modes; DrawMesh per-environ rewrite (:3934) matches RndEnviron::sCurrent swap; pointFalloffMode=1 = 1/(1+d/range) matches GXInitLightAttn (Lit.cpp:38).

topFindings.title: Skin-RTT grey-on-web is an RTT state/colorspace-contract fault, not a lighting bug
topFindings.evidence: Offscreen composite built at frame start (Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:1726-1742 DrawPreClear -> MatSwap::Compose -> DrawRect into kRenderedNoZ RT; two-color shader :3390). Web-vs-native divergence is backend RT format/colorspace (linearToSrgb only applied because web surface is non-sRGB, standard_wgsl.inc:630) or blend/clear defaults (same fragility as REPLACE->white / DEST-MULT->black saga). Timing disproven. Bypassed via direct-bind (memory 266ffb1b).

refactorRecs: Stage 0 (extension, cheap): wire fog from RndEnviron (FogEnable/GetFogStart/End/FogColor); bump light arrays 4->8 (GX cap); populate projLight from environ fakespots (plumbing exists).

Stage 1 (core redesign): replace inverted real/approx heuristic with faithful split (point/fakespot -> HW slots, directional/fill -> ambient); port BoxMapLighting to a 6-axis ambient cube uploaded per environ/object; delete RB3_CHAR_REAL_LIGHT, char ambient caps, grey-key + ambient clamp/floor knobs.
Stage 2: give game.cam a track environ so the highway is environ-lit; delete surface.mat x0.12 / rails-prelit / gem x2 string-keyed material surgery (Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:6160-6205).

Stage 3: implement GX pre-TEV [0,1] channel clamp + drive exposure from environ mExposure/mWhitePoint/mUseToneMapping (loaded at Env.cpp:122, unused); delete venue exposure knobs + softClip knee tuning.

Verify per stage via matched-frame A/B against the Dolphin oracle (t2-dolphin-oracle.md), per-environ, grounded in RB3_VENUE_PROBE light dumps; skin composite: FrameCapture-dump RT native vs web + audit TextureFormat sRGB-ness.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Composite RT format/sample path disagrees on sRGB-ness between Dawn-native and browser WebGPU/ANGLE (linearToSrgb is applied only for the non-sRGB web surface), OR the web backend's RT clear/blend defaults break the SrcAlpha-over-of-diff*color1 base; both collapse diff*tone to grey. Not lighting math; timing disproven.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: flat/over-bright or wrong-colored character faces + venue
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Approx lights are promoted to Lambert directionals instead of folded into a 6-axis box ambient, and the char path reads mLightsReal (point+fakespot only) so directional keys are dropped — the shading model itself is wrong, requiring box-ambient + corrected routing, not more tuning knobs.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: highway/venue look requires constant string-keyed hacks
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: game.cam has no environ, so its lighting is faked by per-material color scaling; any material/venue whose name isn't special-cased is mislit. Faithful fix is to environ-light game.cam.
